faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Face Rating and AI face analysis.

items.title: What is Face Rating?
items.description: Face Rating is an AI face analyzer that scores your attractiveness on a 0–100 scale, detects face shape, measures symmetry and proportions, and highlights your best feature plus your highest-leverage improvement area.

items.title: Is Face Rating free?
items.description: Yes. You can run a free face score and core analysis without creating an account. Deeper reports, detailed plans, and premium add-ons may require a one-time purchase or credits.

items.title: Is my photo private?
items.description: Privacy is a priority. Photos are used only for your analysis, transferred securely, and not sold or used to train public AI models. Free scans are handled with short retention defaults.

items.title: What photo works best?
items.description: Use a clear, front-facing photo with even lighting, a neutral expression, and no heavy filters. Avoid extreme angles, sunglasses, or hair covering major facial landmarks.

items.title: What does the face score mean?
items.description: Your 0–100 score reflects proportional balance, symmetry, and harmony signals from your photo. It is an analysis aid — not a medical diagnosis or a verdict on your worth.

items.title: What is the “highest-leverage area”?
items.description: It is the facial region or presentation factor where improvement is most likely to raise perceived balance first — for example jaw definition, eye region balance, or overall proportions.

items.title: How long does analysis take?
items.description: Most Face Rating scans complete in seconds after upload, depending on image size and network speed.

items.title: Can Face Rating recommend hairstyles?
items.description: Yes. Face shape detection and proportion insights are designed to support hairstyle, frame, and styling guidance matched to your features.
